translate_en|mods/AmmoLootDropB42/42/med:
Chance in percent, per zombie,
for each of the 9 round types.
Default 5 leaves ammo on about
a third of all corpses.
All 9 types roll separately, so 20
already covers nearly every zombie.
Set to 0 to turn the drop off.
translate_en|mods/AmmoLootDropBoxB42/42/:
Chance in percent, per zombie,
for each of the 9 box types.
Default 0.5 is about one box
every 20 to 25 corpses.
A box holds 20 to 50 rounds,
so small values go a long way.
Set to 0 to turn the drop off.
translate_en|mods/AmmoLootDropCartonB42/:
Chance in percent, per zombie,
for each of the 9 carton types.
Default 0.05 is about one carton
every 200 corpses.
A carton is 12 boxes, so even
a rate of 1 makes them common.
Set to 0 to turn the drop off.
